auth: PVA token + Island Gateway headers (env-id, bot-id, tenant-id)
_strategyNote: Component sync is a delta write — request carries componentDelta with per-component changes. Contract asserts envelope shape, not individual component content (those vary by agent design).

requiredFields.constraint: string or null (null for initial sync)

lastVerifiedBy: HAR capture from MCS UI (18 PUT operations observed during agent build)
knownQuirks: Initial sync uses componentDeltaToken: null. Subsequent syncs use the token returned by previous PUT/POST.
MCS returns a NEW componentDeltaToken in every response — callers must persist it for next delta write or they'll receive a full component dump.
Concurrent writes can race: if another actor (UI, second process) writes between your GET and PUT, you'll get a 409 Conflict. Re-pull and re-apply.
Component kinds include GptComponent, DialogComponent, KnowledgeSource, BotEntity — plus extensions not in the vendored schema.
nonContractualFields: $.componentDelta[*].content — per-component free-form payload (depends on component kind)
response.components — list of all components in the bot (can be large, varies by agent design)
response.componentDeltaToken — opaque string; changes every response

errorCases.reason: ConcurrencyVersionMismatch — token is stale. Re-pull before write.
Invalid PVA token or missing Island Gateway headers
